HOW IT WORKS (Async) 1. Sign up any time during the 7-day signup window (Discord must be linked) 2. On lock, bracket is built and first-round matches activate 3. Coordinate with your opponent via /dm-opponent on Discord 4. Both of you enable Ranked, join any private lobby in ROUNDS, play the BO3 5. Mod records the result automatically - no manual report, no room code needed 6. Winner advances in bracket; loser drops to LB (or is eliminated) AUTO-RECORDING REQUIREMENTS * Both players must have Ranked toggled ON in-game when playing * Any private ROUNDS lobby works - tournament doesn't force a specific room * Once you hit 2 BO3 wins, the mod advances the bracket and notifies you SCHEDULING * No fixed start time - self-paced, 7 days per match * Total tournament runs up to 6-9 weeks depending on how fast matches happen * Miss the deadline and you forfeit that match (tracked in penalty %) FORMAT * Double-elim BO3 - lose once, you drop to losers bracket * Grand Final: WB champ vs LB champ (bracket reset if LB wins first BO3) * All matches count toward ranked Elo PENALTY % * Grows when you sign up but forfeit a match by missing the 7-day deadline

HOW IT WORKS (Sync) 1. Pick every start time you can make, then sign up (Discord must be linked) 2. It locks when 8+ players agree on one time - decided 2 days before the default start, so you always get 24h+ notice; players who can't make the winning time are removed (no penalty) 3. Have ROUNDS open at start time (main menu is fine - no tab-sitting needed) 4. Mod auto-connects you to your opponent - no queue, no invites 5. Play BO3, bracket advances automatically - plan for a couple of hours total BETWEEN MATCHES * ~7 min breather before each of your matches after round 1 * Both players press Play Now to skip the break and start early * Show up within 10 min of your match or forfeit * Bracket hidden until start (no scouting your first opponent) FORMAT * Double-elim BO3 (first to 2) - losing once drops you to the losers bracket * Matches run in parallel: your next match schedules the moment its players are known * Top seeds get byes when fewer than 16 sign up * Grand Final: WB champ vs LB champ (bracket reset if LB wins first BO3) * All matches count toward ranked Elo PENALTY % * Grows when you sign up but no-show at match time * Lower penalty = priority if more than 16 sign up

Free-for-all for 3-10 players. Every player is their own team. Standard ROUNDS scoring - first to {0} points takes the game. HOW TO PLAY - There is no Elo band. Joining a lobby is consent to play. - Create a lobby, or join an open one from the browser. The HOST presses Start once at least 3 players are in (up to 10). Several lobbies can be open at once. - If the host leaves, the longest-waiting member becomes the new host automatically. - After each point, everyone except the point winner picks a card at the same time. - The pick timer is shown on screen. A pick landing near the end grants everyone a little extra time. When your timer hits zero, your highlighted card is picked for you automatically. You always get a card - skipping a pick is not possible. - You hold up to {1} cards. Picking one more replaces your oldest card. HOST SETTINGS - The host can tune the lobby before starting: score target (3-10), opening draws, max cards held (3-6), the Same Cards rule, and ranked/casual. - Same Cards rule: everyone's Nth card draw offers the SAME candidates, in the same order - if you and a rival were offered identical cards all game, no result can be blamed on draw luck. One-copy cards (like Phoenix) appear at most once per game for everyone. - After a settings change the lobby cannot start for 60 seconds (and briefly after someone new joins), so everyone can read what changed. Casual lobbies pay reduced rewards and never touch ratings. RATING - FFA is ranked with its own Glicko rating. - Placement uses points, then all round wins earned (spent ones included), then kills. Remaining ties share a place using competition order: 1, 2, 2, 4. - Your rating is scored against the players placed nearest to you (up to 4 of them), so one game can't swing your rating several times harder in a 10-player lobby than in a 3-player one. - A tied placement counts as a draw. New ratings move fast and settle down as you play more. REWARDS - Pay is metered on the FIGHTING, not on flat per-game numbers: decisive rounds are the work unit, and elapsed time caps how fast they cash in - stall tactics are held to a bounded edge, and longer, bigger games pay more. - Bigger lobbies pay a better rate per minute, and a 10-player FFA is the best gold rate in the game. - Your placement shapes your share: 1st earns about five times last place's cut. Part pays as XP, part as Placement Gold, and a stronger opposing field multiplies the pot (the usual tier bonus). - XP converts to Gold at 100 XP = 1 Gold, and level-ups pay their usual bonus Gold. A level-up landing during a game shows up inside that game's +g number - that is how a last place can occasionally out-earn the winner. - Spectators can bet Gold on FFA lobbies from this tab. READING THE RECENT FFAS LIST Dots + N(P) - Full points won. Half dots + N(H) - Round wins that did not become one of that player's full points. Nk - Kills. +xp +g - That game's XP and Gold (including any level-up bonus). Green/red number - FFA rating change. Cards - The hand held at game end. +N replaced counts picks that were pushed out by the card cap - hover the line to see every pick in order. LEADERBOARD COLUMNS Rank - Position in the currently selected sort. Player - The player's display name. Rating - The player's separate FFA Glicko rating. Games - Recorded FFA games played. Wins - Games finished in 1st place. Top3 - Games finished in 1st, 2nd, or 3rd. AvgPl - Average finishing place. Lower is better - 1.0 means winning every game. WR - Share of games won outright. GOTCHAS - Leaving mid-game is recorded. A leaver keeps their tallies for placement.

One solo player faces a duo in a best-of-3 series. HOW TO PLAY - This is a consent queue with no Elo band and no ready-up. - The server assigns one solo and two duo players. - Solo Extra Initial Pick is optional. If anyone enables it, the solo draws 2 cards on the opening pick. SCORING - The first side to win 2 games wins the series. - 1v2 is an UNRANKED beta. No rating is applied yet. - Games are recorded and will count when ranked play launches. REWARDS - Each game gives 500 XP. A game win gets x1.5, for 750 XP. - A series win gives each winner 40 Gold. A series loss gives each loser 20 Gold. - Game XP converts to Gold at 100 XP = 1 Gold. LEADERBOARD COLUMNS - The tab has separate Solo and Duo boards. - You appear only on boards for roles you have played. Rank - Activity order: wins, then WR, then games. Player - The player's display name. W-L - Games won and lost in that role only. WR - Win rate for games in that role. - These are activity boards. They are not sorted by Gold. GOTCHAS - Leaving mid-game is recorded.

This mod sends data to a private server run by the mod author to power the leaderboard and ranked matchmaking.

What gets recorded if you allow:
  • Your Steam ID and in-game display name
  • Your Discord ID and username, ONLY if you link your Discord via the in-game link code
  • Each match you play: rounds won, points, duration, cards picked, cards offered, opponent
  • Your Glicko-2 rating history

Two teams of two play a best-of-3 series. HOW TO PLAY - Random queue uses an Elo band that widens as you wait. The server auto-balances the teams. - Custom lobbies have no Elo band. Joining the lobby is consent to play. - All 4 players have 120 seconds to ready up. If time expires, everyone returns to searching. - After an auto-queue game with a point margin of 3 or more, the weakest winner may swap with the strongest loser. SCORING - The first team to win 2 games wins the series. - 2v2 uses its own Glicko rating. It does not change your 1v1 rating. - Rating updates after the completed series. - W-L and WR count completed series, not individual games. REWARDS - Each game gives 600 base XP. A game win gets x1.5, for 900 base XP. - A series win gives 50 base Gold. A series loss gives 25 base Gold. - The opposing team's rating tier can multiply base rewards. - Game XP converts to Gold at 100 XP = 1 Gold. LEADERBOARD COLUMNS Rank - Position in the currently selected sort. Player - The player's display name. Rating - The player's separate 2v2 Glicko rating. W-L - Completed series won and lost. WR - Series wins divided by completed series. Avg Mate Elo - Average rating of past teammates. A teammate uses 2v2 rating after 5 completed series. Before that, their 1v1 rating is used, or 1500 if absent. Gold - Lifetime Gold earned from 2v2 only. XP - Lifetime XP earned from 2v2 only. Gold and XP do not affect your rating-based rank. GOTCHAS - Leaving mid-game is recorded.
